title: 2026 Crayon Shin-chan Film Opens in the Philipines in November
content: Muse Asia announced on Thursday that its screening of Eiga Crayon Shin-chan Kikikaikai! Ora no Yōkai Bake-shon ( Crayon Shin-chan The Movie Super Strange! My Yōkai Monster Vacation), the 33rd 2D anime film in the Crayon Shin-chan series, will open in the Philippines in November. The film opened in Japan on July 31.
author: ANN

title: Ani-One Asia Streams Kaiju No. 8 'Narumi's Week at Work' Short Anime
content: Ani-One Asia announced on Friday that it has licensed the new " Narumi's Week at Work " ("Narumi no Heijitsu") anime short of Naoya Matsumoto 's Kaiju No. 8 manga, and will begin streaming the anime on Saturday, September 5 at 7:00 p.m. GMT +8.
author: ANN

title: MVM Announces Date Changes
content: MVM has announced in its X/Twitter feed that some of its upcoming home releases have been delayed. 2.5 Dimensional Seduction , pictured right, has gone back to October 26; I Parry Everything has gone back to November 23.
author: ANN

title: Anime Composer Yasuharu Takanashi Will Appear With His Band in Camden on October 2
content: The concert is described on the Dingwalls website as "an explosive fusion of anime epicness and the power of live metal." Yasuharu Takanashi has composed music for anime such as Naruto Shippūden , Fairy Tail , Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Crystal , Boruto: Naruto Next Generations , Kengan Ashura , Fresh Pretty Cure ,…
author: ANN

title: Disney+ in UK Adds First 92 Episodes of One Piece
content: The website AnimeBluRayUK reports the opening three TV anime seasons of One Piece , consisting of the first 92 episodes, are now available on Disney+ in the UK. The episodes are available both subtitled and English-dubbed.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Releases Creditless Second Anime Opening Featuring "BOYS & GIRLS" by LM.C
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its second opening, featuring the song “BOYS & GIRLS” by rock duo LM.C. The song was used in Episodes 27-51, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ha-young Exits Live-Action Trauma Code: Heroes on Call Season 2 Series
content: Actress Ha-young will not return for the upcoming season of the webtoon-based live-action series The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call following controversy surrounding allegations about her great-grandfather's activities during the Japanese colonial period.
author: ANN

title: Yowaki MAX Reijo Nano ni Anime Reveals New Visual, Trailer, Additional Cast, Theme Songs, October 4 Premiere
content: The previously announced Yowaki MAX Reijo Nano ni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta (Even Though I’m a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet From My Cunning Fiancé) anime revealed a new visual and trailer, along with the theme songs, additional cast, and October 4 premiere date.
author: Anime Corner

title: Webtoon-Based Short-Form Live-Action Series My Father's Table Set for September 9 Theatrical Release
content: Director Joon-ik Lee's short-form live-action series My Father's Table , based on the Father's Home Meal webtoon by Gorita, will receive a theatrical release in South Korea on September 9.
author: ANN

title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 2nd STAGE New Preview Images Revealed
content: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure 2ND STAGE revealed new preview images ahead of its September 25 premiere on Netflix. The anime previously confirmed 11 episodes for stages 2 and 3, along with weekly streaming .
author: Anime Corner
